paragraphs.text: 1. MAY Visnu form and mould the womb, may Tvastar duly shape the forms,
Prajapati infuse the stream, and Dhatar lay the germ for thee.
paragraphs.original: आ सिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते
paragraphs.translit: ā siñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te

paragraphs.text: 2. O Sinivali, set the germ, set thou the germ, Sarasvati:
paragraphs.original: गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति ।
paragraphs.translit: garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati |

paragraphs.text: May the Twain Gods bestow the germ, the Asvins crowned with lotuses.
paragraphs.original: गर्भं ते अश्विनौ देवावा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा
paragraphs.translit: garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā

paragraphs.text: 3. That which the Asvins Twain rub forth with the attrition-sticks of gold,-
That germ of thine we invocate, that in the tenth month thou mayst bear.
paragraphs.original: तं ते गर्भं हवामहे दशमे मासि सूतवे
paragraphs.translit: taṃ te garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave
